prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Dallas for a truck accident case?
engine_stated_criteria: which attorney will personally handle your case
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t an objectively “best” lawyer for every truck accident case. For a serious Dallas-area crash, I’d start by interviewing **two or three attorneys who regularly handle commercial-trucking cases and have taken them to trial**.

A few options to research—not endorsements—include:

- **Arnold & Itkin**: reports a Dallas County truck-case verdict and other commercial-vehicle results.
- **Jerry D. Andrews, P.C.**: reports truck-accident recoveries and says its attorney is board-certified in Personal Injury Trial Law.
- **Zinda Law Group**: lists trucking-case verdicts and settlements, including a commercial-vehicle verdict.
- **Adley Law Firm**: reports major Texas trucking verdicts and identifies its founder as board-certified in Personal Injury Trial Law.

When you speak with firms, ask **which attorney will personally handle your case**, their experience with cases like yours, whether they’ve tried trucking cases, who pays case expenses, and the fee percentage. Past results are not a guarantee, and advertised figures may involve very different facts.

You can also contact the **Dallas Bar Association Lawyer Referral Service at (214) 220-7444** for a referral. If the crash was recent, preserve photos, messages, and medical records, and avoid giving recorded statements to an insurer before getting legal advice.
